decisions.rationale: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma is a distinct entity that typically presents with systemic symptoms and does not typically involve the central nervous system in the same way as PCNSL.

Secondary CNS involvement by systemic diffuse large B-cell lymphoma would typically be associated with a history of systemic lymphoma and would not typically present with the same imaging findings as PCNSL.
Lymphomatosis cerebri variant of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is a subtype of PCNSL, but the clinical presentation and imaging findings are more consistent with PCNSL.
